Walking test with standing up from a chair. Sit with your back against the chair. When I say go, stand up, walk at your normal pace to the line on the floor, turn, walk back to the chair and sit down again. There is no hurry: walk as you usually do.
Test del cammino di sei minuti. Al mio v: Six-minute walk test. When I say go, walk back and forth between the two cones, covering as much ground as you can. You may slow down or stop to rest if you need to, and start again as soon as you can. I will tell you when the six minutes are up.
Test del tocco delle dita. Tenga la mano: Finger tapping test. Hold your hand still in front of the phone, with your thumb and index finger clearly visible. When I say go, tap the tip of your index finger on the tip of your thumb ten times in a row, as fast as you can, opening your fingers as wide as possible each time.
Test dell'equilibrio. Resti in piedi nel: Balance test. Stand in the position you were shown, with your eyes open. You may move your arms or body to keep your balance, but do not move your feet. Hold the position until I say stop.

Test delle alzate dalla sedia in trenta: Thirty-second chair stand test. Sit in the middle of the chair with your feet flat on the floor and your arms crossed over your chest. When I say go, stand up fully and then sit back down, as many times as you can, without using your arms. I will tell you when to stop.
Test delle cinque alzate dalla sedia. Si: Five times sit to stand test. Sit with your back against the chair and your arms crossed over your chest. When I say go, stand up and sit down five times in a row, as fast as you can, standing up fully each time. After the fifth time, stay seated.
